verdict.rationale: The core engine is MIT-licensed on npm, and the pricing page says games you created keep working without the licence, so shipped games are structurally protected from being repriced. Paid tiers also include full commercial rights and transferable licences. However, the pack shows no history of stable pricing or license terms, and no explicit vendor commitment against retroactive changes. Missing for 10: documented track record of unchanged pricing/license terms over time, explicit no-retroactive-change policy, independent or community corroboration of licensing stability.
